survey: A round wall clock seen almost straight on, tilted only slightly. A thick orange round frame holds a flat white dial. The frame stays an even circle, and a soft shadow on the striped green background shows the clock hangs flat on the wall. The dial has 12 navy hour marks: longer bars at 12, 3, 6 and 9 and shorter ones elsewhere, all pointing to the centre and evenly spaced. Rows of minute dots run between them. Three hands share one navy centre cap. The hour hand points to about 10 and is shorter than the minute hand, which points to about 2, so the time reads the classic 10:10. A thin red second hand points down to 6, with a short tail above the cap. Every hand comes out of the centre pivot, and nothing floats, passes through another part or is missing.
